cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how CrymadX ("we," "us," or "our") uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our cryptocurrency exchange platform at crymadx.io (the "Platform"). It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.
cookies.readAlongside: This policy should be read alongside our
cookies.readAlongsideEnd: , which sets out how and why we collect and use personal data.
cookies.essentialRequiredDesc: Cannot be disabled; necessary for Platform operation

section1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
section1.intro: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer, smartphone, or other device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide information to the owners of the site, and enable certain features.
section1.sessionCookiesDesc: Temporary cookies that are erased when you close your browser. They are used to track your actions during a single browsing session.
section1.persistentCookiesDesc: Cookies that remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them. They are used to remember your preferences and actions across multiple sessions.
section1.firstPartyDesc: Set by CrymadX directly. These cookies are under our control and are used to provide our services, remember your preferences, and improve your experience.

section2.title: 2. Similar Technologies
section2.intro: In addition to cookies, we may use other similar technologies to track and store information:
section2.webBeaconsDesc: Small transparent images embedded in web pages or emails. They allow us to know if you have viewed a page or opened an email, and to collect certain information about your device and browser. Web beacons are used in conjunction with cookies to measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.
section2.localStorageDesc: A technology that allows websites to store data locally within your browser. Unlike cookies, local storage data is not sent to the server with every request. We use local storage to store your preferences, cache data for faster performance, and maintain application state.
section2.sessionStorageDesc: Similar to local storage but the data is cleared when you close your browser tab. We use session storage for temporary data that should not persist, such as form data and temporary authentication states during multi-step processes.
section2.indexedDBDesc: A low-level browser API for storing large amounts of structured data. We may use IndexedDB to cache market data, price histories, and other information to improve Platform performance and enable offline functionality.
section2.fingerprintingDesc: A technique that collects information about your device configuration (such as screen resolution, installed fonts, and browser plugins) to create a unique identifier. We use this technology for security purposes, specifically for fraud detection and prevention, and to identify suspicious login attempts.

section3.title: 3. Why We Use Cookies
section3.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes:
section3.essentialList1: Authenticating users and maintaining secure sessions
section3.essentialList2: Protecting against cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks
section3.essentialList3: Processing transactions and maintaining order state
section3.essentialList5: Preventing fraud and detecting suspicious activity
section3.essentialList6: Load balancing and ensuring Platform stability
section3.functionalList1: Remembering your language and currency preferences
section3.functionalList3: Saving your trading chart settings and indicators
section3.functionalList4: Maintaining your favorite trading pairs list
section3.analyticsList1: Understanding how users interact with our Platform
section3.analyticsList2: Identifying popular features and areas for improvement
section3.analyticsList3: Measuring the effectiveness of new features
section3.analyticsList5: Optimizing Platform performance and load times
section3.analyticsList6: Analyzing user journeys to improve navigation
section3.marketingList1: Showing relevant advertisements on other platforms
section3.marketingList2: Measuring the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns
section3.marketingList3: Understanding how users arrive at our Platform
section3.marketingList4: Attributing conversions to the correct marketing channels

section4.title: 4. Cookie Categories & Details
section4.intro: Below is a detailed breakdown of the cookies we use, organized by category. Each category includes a list of specific cookies, their purposes, providers, and duration.

category.essentialDesc: These cookies are strictly necessary for the Platform to function and cannot be switched off. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in, or filling in forms.
category.functionalDesc: These cookies enable the Platform to provide enhanced functionality and personalization. They may be set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies, some or all of these services may not function properly.
category.analyticsDesc: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our Platform. They help us understand which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the Platform. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous.
category.marketingDesc: These cookies may be set through our Platform by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device.

section5.title: 5. Third-Party Cookies
section5.intro: We use services from third-party providers that may set their own cookies on your device. We do not control these cookies and recommend reviewing their respective privacy policies.
section5.googleDesc: We use Google Analytics for website analytics, Google Ads for advertising, and Google OAuth for authentication. Google may use the data collected to contextualize and personalize ads across their network.
section5.metaDesc: We use Facebook Pixel for advertising measurement and conversion tracking. Meta may use information collected to improve their advertising services.
section5.cloudflareDesc: We use Cloudflare for security, DDoS protection, and content delivery. Cloudflare sets cookies for bot management and security verification purposes.
section5.tradingviewDesc: We use TradingView widgets for charting functionality. TradingView may set cookies to remember your chart settings and preferences.
section5.hotjarDesc: We use Hotjar for behavior analytics and user feedback. Hotjar helps us understand how users interact with our Platform through heatmaps and session recordings (with sensitive data masked).
section5.mixpanelDesc: We use Mixpanel for product analytics to understand user behavior and improve our Platform. Mixpanel helps us track events and user interactions.
section5.twitterDesc: We use Twitter/X for social sharing and advertising. Twitter may use data for ad personalization and measurement.

section6.title: 6. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
section6.intro: You have several options for managing cookies:
section6.bannerIntro: When you first visit our Platform, you will see a cookie consent banner that allows you to:
section6.bannerList3: Customize your preferences for each cookie category
section6.bannerChange: You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer of our Platform.
section6.optOutIntro: You can opt out of certain types of cookies using these industry tools:
section6.gaOptOutDesc: Browser add-on to prevent Google Analytics tracking
section6.warningText: If you disable or block certain cookies, some features of our Platform may not function properly. Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are required for the Platform to operate securely. Blocking essential cookies may prevent you from logging in, executing trades, or accessing your account.

section7.title: 7. Do Not Track Signals
section7.p1: Some browsers include a "Do Not Track" (DNT) feature that signals to websites that you visit that you do not want to have your online activity tracked.
section7.p2: Currently, there is no universally accepted standard for how companies should respond to DNT signals. As such, our Platform does not currently respond to DNT signals. However, you can manage your tracking preferences through our cookie consent banner and the opt-out tools described above.
section7.p3: If a universal standard for responding to DNT signals is established, we will update our practices accordingly.

section8.title: 8. Cookies on Mobile Devices
section8.intro: When you access our Platform through a mobile device or our mobile application, we may use similar technologies to cookies, including:
section8.deviceIdsDesc: Unique identifiers assigned to your mobile device (such as IDFA for iOS or GAID for Android) that help us recognize your device.
section8.sdksDesc: Software development kits from third parties that may collect information similar to cookies.
section8.mobileStorageDesc: Data stored locally on your device by our mobile application.
section8.manage: You can manage mobile identifiers and tracking through your device settings:
section8.iosInstructions: Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking → Toggle "Allow Apps to Request to Track"
section8.androidInstructions: Go to Settings → Privacy → Ads → Enable "Opt out of Ads Personalization"

section9.title: 9. Cookie Data Retention
section9.intro: Different cookies have different retention periods. The specific duration for each cookie is listed in Section 4 (Cookie Categories & Details). In general:
section9.sessionNote: Deleted when you close your browser
section9.footer: You can delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Clearing cookies will sign you out of your account and reset your preferences.

section10.title: 10. Legal Basis for Cookie Use
section10.intro: Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the ePrivacy Directive, we rely on different legal bases depending on the type of cookie:
section10.essentialText: Essential cookies are strictly necessary for the provision of our services. We do not require your consent for these cookies as they are exempt under Article 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive. Without these cookies, we cannot provide you with the services you have requested.
section10.consentText: For all non-essential cookies, we rely on your consent as the legal basis. When you first visit our Platform, you will be asked to provide your consent through our cookie banner. You can withdraw your consent at any time by changing your cookie preferences.
section10.moreInfo: For more information about the legal basis for our data processing activities, please see our

section11.title: 11. International Data Transfers
section11.intro: Some of our third-party cookie providers may transfer data outside of the European Economic Area (EEA). When this happens, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place:
section11.sccsDesc: We use EU-approved standard contractual clauses with providers that transfer data outside the EEA.
section11.adequacyDesc: Some transfers may be to countries that the European Commission has deemed to provide adequate data protection.
section11.dpfDesc: For US-based providers, we may rely on their certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where applicable.
section11.contact: You can request more information about the specific safeguards used for international transfers by contacting us at privacy@crymadx.io.

section12.p1: Our Platform is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children, and our cookies are not designed to track or identify minors.
section12.p2: If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child under 18 through cookies or other means, we will take steps to delete that information as soon as possible. If you believe we may have collected data from a minor, please contact us immediately.

section13.title: 13. Updates to This Policy
section13.intro: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in:
section13.changesIntro: When we make material changes to this policy, we will:
section13.changesList1: Update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page
section13.changesList2: Display a notice on our Platform
section13.changesList3: Ask you to review and accept the updated policy when appropriate
section13.changesList4: For significant changes, we may reset your cookie preferences and ask for fresh consent
section13.footer: We encourage you to periodically review this page for the latest information about our cookie practices.

section14.title: 14. Contact Us
section14.intro: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy or our use of cookies, please contact us:

1.content: This Privacy Policy applies to all users of CrymadX, including visitors to our website, registered users, and anyone who interacts with our Services. It covers all personal data processed by CrymadX, regardless of how it is collected or processed.

3.title: 1.3 Consent

3.item5: Keep your devices and software updated

section9.title: 9. Data Security
section9.intro: We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.

1.title: 10.1 Right of Access
1.content: You have the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you. We will provide this information in a commonly used electronic format within 30 days of your request.

2.title: 10.2 Right to Rectification
2.content: You have the right to request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal information we hold about you. You can update most information directly in your account settings.

3.title: 10.3 Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
3.intro: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data in certain circumstances, such as when:
3.item1: The data is no longer necessary for its original purpose
3.item2: You withdraw consent and there is no other legal basis for processing
3.item3: You object to processing and there are no overriding legitimate grounds
3.item4: The data has been unlawfully processed
3.note: Note: We may need to retain certain data for legal compliance (e.g., AML requirements).

4.title: 10.4 Right to Restriction
4.content: You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances, such as while we verify the accuracy of your data or assess your objection to processing.

5.title: 10.5 Right to Data Portability
5.content: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and to transmit that data to another controller where technically feasible.

6.title: 10.6 Right to Object
6.content: You have the right to object to processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests, including direct marketing. Where you object to direct marketing, we will stop processing your data for that purpose immediately.

7.title: 10.7 Right to Withdraw Consent
7.content: Where processing is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal.

8.title: 10.8 Right to Lodge a Complaint
8.content: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe that our processing of your personal data violates applicable data protection laws.

9.title: 10.9 Exercising Your Rights
9.content: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through our support ticket system. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request. We will respond to your request within 30 days.

section4.title: 4. Description of Services
section4.intro: CrymadX provides a digital asset exchange platform that enables users to buy, sell, trade, stake, and earn on various cryptocurrencies and digital assets. Our Services include:

sub1.title: 4.1 Spot Trading
sub1.content: Our spot trading service allows you to buy and sell cryptocurrencies at current market prices. We provide a matching engine that connects buyers and sellers, order books, and various order types including market orders, limit orders, and stop-limit orders.

sub2.title: 4.2 Staking Services
sub2.content: Our staking service enables you to stake supported cryptocurrencies to earn staking rewards. Staking involves locking your assets for a specified period and participating in the consensus mechanism of various blockchain networks.

sub3.title: 4.3 Savings and Earn Products
sub3.content: We offer various savings and earning products that allow you to deposit your cryptocurrencies and earn interest over time. These products have varying terms, interest rates, and conditions that are disclosed at the time of deposit.

sub4.title: 4.4 P2P Trading
sub4.content: Our peer-to-peer (P2P) trading platform enables users to trade directly with each other using various payment methods. CrymadX acts as an escrow service to facilitate secure transactions between parties.

sub5.title: 4.5 Service Availability
sub5.content: While we strive to maintain continuous availability of our Services, we do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Services may be temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, upgrades, technical issues, or factors beyond our control.

sub1.title: 5.1 Order Execution
sub1.content: All orders placed on CrymadX are executed on a best-effort basis. We do not guarantee the execution of any order at any specific price or time. Market conditions, liquidity, and other factors may affect order execution.

sub2.title: 5.2 Trading Limits
sub2.intro: Trading limits are determined based on your account verification level. Higher verification levels unlock greater trading limits:
sub2.item1: Unverified accounts: Limited or no trading access
sub2.outro: Specific limits are displayed in your account dashboard and may be adjusted by CrymadX at any time based on risk assessment, regulatory requirements, or other factors.

sub3.title: 5.3 Order Cancellation
sub3.content: You may cancel unfilled or partially filled orders at any time before execution. Once an order is fully executed, it cannot be cancelled or reversed. CrymadX reserves the right to cancel orders in exceptional circumstances, including but not limited to suspected fraud, market manipulation, or system errors.

sub4.title: 5.4 Market Manipulation
sub4.intro: Any form of market manipulation is strictly prohibited, including but not limited to:
sub4.item1: Wash trading (trading with yourself to create artificial volume)
sub4.item2: Spoofing (placing orders with intent to cancel before execution)
sub4.item3: Layering (placing multiple orders at different prices with intent to manipulate)
sub4.item4: Front-running (trading ahead of known pending orders)

sub1.title: 6.1 Staking Mechanics
sub1.content: When you stake assets through CrymadX, you delegate your assets to participate in blockchain validation processes. Staking rewards are distributed according to the rules of the underlying blockchain protocol and CrymadX's fee structure.

sub2.title: 6.2 Lock-up Periods
sub2.content: Certain staking products may have lock-up or unbonding periods during which your assets cannot be withdrawn or traded. These periods vary by asset and are clearly disclosed before you stake. You acknowledge that you will not have access to your staked assets during these periods.

sub3.title: 6.3 Staking Rewards
sub3.content: Staking rewards are estimates and are not guaranteed. Actual rewards may vary based on network conditions, validator performance, and other factors. Rewards are typically distributed according to the schedule of the underlying blockchain protocol.

sub4.title: 6.4 Slashing Risks
sub4.content: Some proof-of-stake networks implement slashing mechanisms that may result in loss of staked assets due to validator misbehavior or downtime. While CrymadX takes measures to minimize these risks, you acknowledge that slashing events may occur and result in partial loss of your staked assets.

sub1.title: 7.1 Escrow Service
sub1.content: CrymadX provides escrow services for P2P transactions. When a trade is initiated, the seller's cryptocurrency is held in escrow until the buyer confirms payment. The escrow protects both parties by ensuring the seller has the assets and the buyer's payment is verified before release.

sub2.title: 7.2 Trade Obligations
sub2.intro: When you initiate or accept a P2P trade, you are obligated to complete the transaction according to its terms. Failure to complete trades may result in:
sub2.item1: Negative feedback on your trading profile
sub2.item2: Temporary or permanent suspension from P2P trading
sub2.item4: Forfeiture of escrowed assets in case of fraud

sub3.title: 7.3 Dispute Resolution
sub3.content: If a dispute arises in a P2P transaction, either party may open a dispute for CrymadX to review. We will review the evidence provided by both parties and make a determination based on our dispute resolution policies. Our decision is final and binding.

sub4.title: 7.4 Prohibited P2P Conduct
sub4.intro: The following conduct is prohibited in P2P trading:
sub4.item1: Using payment methods that do not belong to you
sub4.item4: Chargebacks or payment reversals after release of crypto
sub4.item5: Harassment or threats against trading partners

sub1.title: 8.1 Trading Fees
sub1.content: CrymadX charges trading fees on all executed trades. Fees are calculated as a percentage of the trade value and may vary based on your trading volume, membership tier, or promotional offers. Current fee schedules are available on our website and in your account dashboard.

sub2.title: 8.2 Withdrawal Fees
sub2.content: Withdrawal fees are charged to cover blockchain network transaction costs. These fees vary by cryptocurrency and network conditions. Current withdrawal fees are displayed at the time of withdrawal and are subject to change without notice.

sub3.title: 8.3 Deposit Fees
sub3.content: CrymadX generally does not charge fees for cryptocurrency deposits. However, you are responsible for any network fees required to send assets to your CrymadX wallet. Some fiat deposit methods may incur fees from third-party payment processors.

sub4.title: 8.4 Staking and Earn Fees
sub4.content: CrymadX may charge fees on staking rewards and interest earned through our savings products. These fees are deducted from your rewards before distribution and are disclosed in the product terms.

sub5.title: 8.5 Fee Changes
sub5.content: CrymadX reserves the right to modify fees at any time. Changes to fees will be communicated through our platform and will take effect at the time specified in the notice.

section10.warning: IMPORTANT: Trading cryptocurrencies involves substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for all investors. You should carefully consider whether trading is appropriate for you in light of your financial condition.

sub1.content: Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile. Prices can fluctuate significantly in short periods, and you may experience substantial gains or losses. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

sub3.title: 10.3 Regulatory Risks
sub3.content: The regulatory environment for cryptocurrencies is evolving and uncertain. Changes in laws or regulations may adversely affect the use, transfer, exchange, or value of cryptocurrencies.

sub4.title: 10.4 Technology Risks
sub4.content: Blockchain technology and smart contracts may contain bugs, vulnerabilities, or defects that could result in the loss of assets. CrymadX is not responsible for losses resulting from blockchain network issues, smart contract failures, or similar technical problems.

sub5.content: Despite our security measures, there is always a risk of cyberattacks, hacking, or other security breaches that could result in the loss of assets. You acknowledge this risk and agree that CrymadX's liability is limited as set forth in these Terms.

sub6.title: 10.6 Liquidity Risks
sub6.content: Some cryptocurrencies may have limited liquidity, making it difficult to buy or sell at desired prices. In extreme market conditions, you may not be able to execute trades at all.

sub7.content: Losing access to your account credentials, 2FA devices, or recovery information may result in permanent loss of access to your assets. CrymadX may not be able to help you recover access in all circumstances.
